caption:
Momo has been pruning the garden for hours, and lately her thumb aches every time she squeezes the secateurs.

Squeezing hard over and over can tire out the muscles and tendons around your thumb. Keeping blades sharp and using loppers for thicker branches may help ease the load.

Hybi's tip: switch to a different garden job every 15–20 minutes, and open and close your hand 10 times while you rest.

Swelling or warmth, numbness, a weaker grip or pain that hangs around for more than two weeks is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
